title: Replay refusal-rule changes over 50 accepted readings via check-reading
summary: Retry of job 20261028-034820-v3rf. Add an `athena check-reading` subcommand that applies reading acceptance rules to a stored request and reading. After checks pass, replay the newest 50 accepted readings through the base and candidate builds, and hold the job if more than 10% are newly refused (unless its criteria intend a higher rate). The result is recorded only in brief-verifier.md and the hold finding, never in a new `<job>/replay.md`. The audience is the maintainers and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test.
Each criterion names a test that runs the replay, hold and brief behavior.
An empty history is reported as no replay, not a pass.
The CHANGELOG entry is written for outside readers.
The hold is enforced in the run pipeline by a code constant, not by prose.
The replay is generic over any rule change and does not match this one incident.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261028-034820-v3rf failed in planning round 3. Its major finding (replay.md refused by check_record_file, JOB_MARKDOWN in athena-data records.rs) is fixed by recording the replay only in the brief-verifier.md section and in the Athena Blocker finding in verification.json. No new file is created in the job directory and athena-data is not touched.

Minor finding 1 is fixed: a #[cfg(test)] override sits in front of tree resolution, build and subcommand probe, and supplies the base and candidate deciders. The pipeline tests therefore work with the non-Athena `repo()` fixture.
Minor finding 2 is fixed: the override has an explicit skip mode. Tests compare the driver-request list of a skipped run with a replayed run with no rule change, and both make no extra model call.
Nit is fixed: Records::load(&self.git, &head) is used as at run/mod.rs:166. There is no open question.

A skipped replay ('no replay: checks failed', 'no replay: no history', or a missing tree or subcommand) is written as a `no replay: <reason>` line in the brief-verifier.md section. That section is written on every path.
The 10% threshold is a code constant. The prior reading's behavior criteria are kept, with the changes above.
Deliverables and out_of_scope of the earlier job are carried over unchanged. athena-data is not a deliverable.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new `athena check-reading` subcommand takes a stored request and reading and prints accept or refuse with the reason, using the same acceptance rules as reading.rs; a fixture test shows it (cargo test -p athena-cli).
A test builds a candidate-like rule change over fixture records and shows the newly refused requests (refused by candidate, accepted by base) are listed with the count (cargo test -p athena-core).
A test shows the replay uses only the newest 50 requests that have accepted readings, and that an empty history gives 'no replay: <reason>' and not a pass (cargo test -p athena-core).

A test shows more than 10% newly refused is held with the list, exactly 10% or less is not held, and a candidate whose criteria intend a higher rate is not held, with the replay still in the brief (cargo test -p athena-core).

A pipeline test in run/mod.rs holds a candidate over the threshold (Rejected, not landed) and asserts that the committed brief-verifier.md section and the Athena Blocker finding name the list, and that the records check accepts the job directory; no replay.md is created (cargo test -p athena-core).

A pipeline test with the replay skipped, and one with no rule change, show the driver request list equals the existing producer-plus-verifier list, so the replay makes no model call (cargo test -p athena-core).

A test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs shows the verifier brief carries the replay summary (newly refused count, total, list), or `no replay: <reason>`, and stays within its size limit with a very long list (cargo test -p athena-context).
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the subcommand, the replay, the 10% hold, and the verifier brief summary.
git diff shows no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, or crates/athena-data; the 10% threshold is a code constant, and no existing reading rule changed.

out_of_scope: Detecting refusal-rule changes by a flag or by matching diffs
Changing crates/athena-data, including the records allow-list
Creating a new committed file such as <job>/replay.md
Adding the pre-critic plan check from the introspection
departures: The change is large and touches the pipeline, so cost, time and pass rate are worse than the reference. The prior attempt spent three planning rounds without landing.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time from failed attempts: job 20261028-034820-v3rf failed in planning, and unreplayed refusal rules caused three stopped drains.
hard_reason: Adds a hold rule to the run pipeline: after checks pass it replays readings and can hold a job, and it changes the verifier brief and the landing path.
